mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.product_id,o.product_title,o.quantity,o.total_amount::text AS amount, o.currency,CASE WHEN r.status='SUCCEEDED' THEN 'refunded' ELSE o.status END AS status, p.status AS payment_status,o.payment_id,o.deal_id,g.status AS deal_status, COALESCE(r.status,'NONE') AS refund_status,o.create_time AS created_at FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN biz_payment p ON p.id=o.payment_id AND p.user_id=o.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_refund r ON r.payment_id=p.id AND NOT r.deleted LEFT JOIN biz_group_deal g ON g.id=o.deal_id AND NOT g.deleted WHERE o.user_id=#{buyer} AND NOT o.deleted ORDER BY o.create_time DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM biz_order WHERE user_id=#{buyer} AND NOT deleted
